title: Headline €2,634 figure ships unconfirmed against the Daft report PDF — the diff's own VERIFY gate is still open at review time
detail: The post's doc comment admits the Dublin figure was taken from "the report and its launch coverage", not the report PDF; the dispatch spec said don't rely on press numbers alone. No check closes this gate before merge.
recommended_fix: Confirm €2,634 against the live Daft Q2 2026 report PDF before merging; if it differs, correct the figure and description, then delete the now-satisfied VERIFY qualifier.
